meta.description: Work and step size for SciPy's RK45, Radau, BDF and LSODA on the stiff consecutive-reaction model A -> B -> C (k1 = 1000, k2 = 1) over t in [0, 5] at rtol 1e-7 / atol 1e-10. The explicit method is held at the absolute-stability ceiling h ~ 3.3/k1 long after the fast transient has died, and pays for it in right-hand-side evaluations; the three stiff-capable methods take steps roughly twenty times larger and reach the same accuracy.
